Case: Company setup page opens with 6 progress dots and read-only server region after email verification
Description:
• Pre-condition: User has verified their email and is redirected to /en/register-company for the first time.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-007 · AC1]
  • Traceability: Setup at /en/register-company: 6 progress dots, Back on steps 2–6, Next or Enter to proceed, "Server region: Singapore" read-only.
Test Steps:
1. Complete email verification to trigger redirect to /en/register-company.
  2. Observe the page structure on step 1.
  3. Check the progress indicator, navigation controls, and server region field.
Expected:
• URL is /en/register-company.
  • 6 progress dots (or equivalent step indicator) are displayed with step 1 active.
  • No Back button is present on step 1.
  • A Next button (or Enter key) is available to proceed.
  • "Server region: Singapore" is displayed as a read-only field (not editable).
BDD: Given a user has verified their email, When they reach /en/register-company, Then the 6-step progress indicator is shown and server region is read-only as Singapore

Case: Required error appears on company name field when user attempts to proceed with it empty
Description:
• Pre-condition: User is on company setup step 1 at /en/register-company. Company name field is empty or has been cleared.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-007 · AC2]
  • Traceability: Company name (required — shows "Required" on empty).
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to /en/register-company step 1.
  2. Clear the company name field (if pre-filled).
  3. Click Next or press Enter to proceed.
  4. Observe validation feedback on the company name field.
Expected:
• Inline error message "Required" is displayed beneath the company name field.
  • The user remains on step 1 and cannot proceed to step 2.
BDD: Given a user is on setup step 1 with an empty company name, When they attempt to proceed, Then a "Required" error is shown and progression is blocked

Case: Website URL error appears when an invalid URL format is entered on setup step 1
Description:
• Pre-condition: User is on company setup step 1 at /en/register-company. Company name field is populated.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-007 · AC2]
  • Traceability: Website ("Please enter a valid website URL" on invalid).
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to /en/register-company step 1.
  2. Enter a valid company name.
  3. Enter an invalid website URL (e.g., "not-a-url" or "ftp://").
  4. Click Next or press Enter.
  5. Observe validation feedback on the website field.
Expected:
• Inline error message "Please enter a valid website URL" is displayed beneath the website field.
  • The user remains on step 1.
BDD: Given a user enters an invalid website URL on setup step 1, When they attempt to proceed, Then the error "Please enter a valid website URL" is shown

Case: Company name and website fields are pre-filled from the email domain on setup step 1 for business email
Description:
• Pre-condition: User signed up with a business domain email (e.g., user@acme.com). User is on /en/register-company step 1.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-007 · AC2]
  • Traceability: Company name and website both pre-filled from the email domain.
Test Steps:
1. Sign up using a business email address (non-free-mail domain, e.g., user@acme.com).
  2. Complete email verification.
  3. Navigate to /en/register-company step 1.
  4. Observe the company name and website fields.
Expected:
• Company name field is pre-filled with a value derived from the email domain (e.g., "Acme" for acme.com).
  • Website field is pre-filled with the domain (e.g., "acme.com" or "https://acme.com").
BDD: Given a user signed up with a business-domain email, When they reach setup step 1, Then company name and website are pre-filled from the email domain

Case: Company name and website fields are empty when a free-mail domain email is used on setup step 1
Description:
• Pre-condition: User signed up with a free-mail domain email (gmail.com, yahoo.com, outlook.com, or icloud.com). User is on /en/register-company step 1.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-007 · AC9]
  • Traceability: Given gmail.com, yahoo.com, outlook.com, icloud.com or similar, setup step 1 shows empty company fields instead of pre-filling domain-based company name.
  • Note: "Or similar" is not fully defined in PRD — test the four named domains; additional domains at tester discretion.
Test Steps:
1. Sign up using a Gmail address (e.g., testuser@gmail.com).
  2. Complete email verification.
  3. Navigate to /en/register-company step 1.
  4. Observe the company name and website fields.
  5. Repeat test with yahoo.com, outlook.com, and icloud.com addresses.
Expected:
• Company name field is empty (not pre-filled with "Gmail", "Yahoo", or similar domain name).
  • Website field is empty.
  • User is prompted to enter their company details manually.
BDD: Given a user signed up with a free-mail domain (gmail.com), When they reach setup step 1, Then company name and website fields are blank

Case: Step 2 advances automatically to step 3 when an industry option is selected
Description:
• Pre-condition: User has completed step 1 and is on setup step 2 (Industry selection) at /en/register-company.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-007 · AC3]
  • Traceability: Industry, single choice of 10 options, moves on when picked.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to setup step 2.
  2. Select any industry option (excluding "Others").
  3. Observe whether the flow automatically advances.
Expected:
• Selecting an industry option immediately advances the user to step 3 (Goal) without requiring a separate Next click.

BDD: Given a user is on setup step 2, When they select any industry option, Then the flow automatically advances to step 3

Case: Please specify your industry text input appears when Others is selected on step 2
Description:
• Pre-condition: User is on setup step 2 (Industry selection).

  • Traceability: "Others" opens "Please specify your industry" text input.

1. Navigate to setup step 2.
  2. Select the "Others" industry option.
  3. Observe the page.
  4. Enter a custom industry name in the text input.
  5. Proceed to the next step.

Case: Step 4 main channel accepts a single selection including the I don't have one option
Description:
• Pre-condition: User has completed steps 1–3 and is on setup step 4 (Main Channel).
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-007 · AC5]
  • Traceability: Main channel (single of 10, incl. "I don't have one").
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to setup step 4.
  2. Select the "I don't have one" main channel option.
  3. Proceed to the other channels section.
  4. Observe that only one main channel can be active at a time.

• The "I don't have one" option is selectable as the main channel.
  • Only one main channel can be selected at a time (selecting a new one deselects the previous).
  • After main channel selection, the other channels (optional multi-select) section is shown.
BDD: Given a user is on setup step 4, When they select "I don't have one" as main channel, Then it is accepted and the other channels section is presented

Case: Other channels can be multi-selected without affecting the main channel selection on step 4
Description:
• Pre-condition: User is on setup step 4. A main channel has been selected.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-007 · AC5]
  • Traceability: Then other channels (optional multi-select).
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to setup step 4 and select a main channel.
  2. Select 2 or more options in the other channels multi-select.
  3. Observe selection state and proceed to step 5.
Expected:
• Multiple other channels can be selected simultaneously.
  • The main channel selection is not affected by other channel selections.
  • Selecting zero other channels is allowed (optional); flow proceeds to step 5.
BDD: Given a user has selected a main channel on step 4, When they select multiple other channels, Then all selections are accepted independently and the main channel is unchanged

Case: Get started button remains disabled when the contact number field contains an invalid phone number on step 6
Description:
• Pre-condition: User has completed steps 1–5 and is on setup step 6. Name field is populated.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-007 · AC7]
  • Traceability: "Get started" disabled until valid; "Enter a valid phone number." on invalid.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to setup step 6.
  2. Enter a valid name.
  3. Enter an invalid phone number (e.g., "abc" or "123").
  4. Observe the state of the "Get started" button.
Expected:
• "Get started" button is disabled (not clickable) while the phone number is invalid.
  • The error message "Enter a valid phone number." is displayed.
BDD: Given a user is on setup step 6 with an invalid phone number, When they attempt to submit, Then "Get started" remains disabled and "Enter a valid phone number." error is shown

Case: Company setup is completed successfully when all required fields on step 6 are valid

  2. Enter a valid full name.
  3. Select a country code and enter a valid phone number for that country.
  4. Click the "Get started" button.

Case: Marketing consent with timestamp is recorded when the newsletter checkbox is ticked before submission
Description:
• Pre-condition: User is on setup step 6. Name and phone number are valid. Newsletter checkbox is visible and unchecked.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-007 · AC8]
  • Traceability: Only a ticked box sets marketing consent, stored with timestamp.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to setup step 6.
  2. Fill in valid name and phone number.
  3. Tick the "Send me product news and offers" checkbox.
  4. Click "Get started" to complete setup.
  5. Post-setup: check marketing consent status in account profile or via API.

• Setup completes successfully.
  • Marketing consent is recorded as opted-in (visible in account settings or confirmed via API response).
  • A consent timestamp is associated with the opt-in record.

Test Steps:

  2. Fill in valid name and phone number.
  3. Leave the "Send me product news and offers" checkbox unchecked.
  4. Click "Get started" to complete setup.

Case: Previously entered data is preserved when Back is used to navigate from step 6 to step 5
Description:
• Pre-condition: User has completed steps 1–5 and is on setup step 6 with some data entered.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-007 · AC1]
  • Traceability: Back on steps 2–6.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to setup step 6 and enter a valid name and phone number.
  2. Click the Back button.
  3. Observe the state of step 5.
  4. Navigate forward again to step 6.
  5. Observe whether step 6 retains previously entered values.
Expected:
• Clicking Back from step 6 returns the user to step 5.
  • Step 5 selections are preserved.
  • Navigating forward to step 6 again shows the previously entered name and phone number (or at minimum does not corrupt the flow).
BDD: Given a user is on setup step 6 with data entered, When they click Back, Then step 5 data is preserved and they can return to step 6
